features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You prepare cleric spells daily from the cleric spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: You choose a Divine Domain associated with your deity, granting domain spells and features at 1st, 2nd, 6th, 8th, and 17th levels.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You can channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. You start with Turn Undead and a domain feature. Uses refresh on a short or long rest; uses per rest scale with level.

features.name: Destroy Undead
features.description: When an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a threshold that increases at 8th, 11th, 14th, and 17th level.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: You can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf. Roll percentile dice; if you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes (as decided by the DM). After a successful intervention, you cannot use this feature again for 7 days. At 20th level, your call succeeds automatically without a roll.

subclasses.name: Knowledge Domain
subclasses.description: The gods of knowledge value learning and understanding above all, granting insight into secrets and lore.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.description: You learn two languages and become proficient in two skills from Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion; your proficiency bonus is doubled for those two skills.

features.name: Knowledge of Ages
features.description: Channel Divinity: You can touch one willing creature and give it advantage on Intelligence ability checks for 10 minutes.

features.name: Read Thoughts
features.description: You can cast Detect Thoughts at will, without expending a spell slot, targeting creatures you can see within 60 feet.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.description: After meditating for 1 minute, you can cast Legend Lore without material components, without expending a spell slot, once per rest.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.description: The Life domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy that sustains all life.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: Channel Divinity: As an action, you restore hit points divided among creatures within 30 feet, up to 5 × your cleric level total, not above half their hit point maximum.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage; this increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you would normally roll dice to restore hit points with a spell, you use the maximum possible result for each die instead.

subclasses.name: Light Domain
subclasses.description: Gods of light promote the ideals of rebirth and renewal, truth and vigilance.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: You learn the Light cantrip if you do not already know it; it does not count against your cantrip total.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When you are attacked by a creature you can see within 30 feet, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. Uses per day equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once).

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: Channel Divinity: As an action, any magical darkness within 30 feet that you created ends, and each hostile creature within 30 feet must make a Constitution save or take radiant damage and be blinded briefly.

features.name: Improved Flare
features.description: You can also use Warding Flare when an ally you can see within 30 feet is attacked.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: You emit bright light in a 60-foot radius; you have advantage on saving throws against spells that deal fire or radiant damage.

subclasses.name: Nature Domain
subclasses.description: Gods of nature are as varied as the natural world itself, from inscrutable gods of the deep forest to deities of harvest.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.description: You learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in one skill from Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Charm Animals and Plants
features.description: Channel Divinity: As an action, each beast or plant creature that can see you within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 1 minute.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant resistance to that instance of damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage (your choice); this becomes 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Master of Nature
features.description: When you charm creatures with Charm Animals and Plants, you can also affect elementals; charmed creatures obey your verbal commands.

subclasses.name: Tempest Domain
subclasses.description: Gods of the storm send thunder and lightning to smite those who oppose them.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to deal lightning or thunder damage. Uses per day equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Destructive Wrath
features.description: Channel Divinity: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.description: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 feet away from you.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage; this becomes 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed whenever you are not underground or indoors.

subclasses.name: Trickery Domain
subclasses.description: Gods of trickery are mischief-makers and instigators who value and uphold the letter of the law more than its spirit.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: As an action, you touch a willing creature other than yourself and give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks; this lasts for 1 hour or until you use this feature again.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: Channel Divinity: As an action, you create an illusory duplicate of yourself within 30 feet for 1 minute. You can cast spells as if you were in the duplicate's space, and you gain advantage on attacks if you and the duplicate flank a target.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: Channel Divinity: As an action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 poison damage; this becomes 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: You can create up to four duplicates with Invoke Duplicity instead of one, and as a bonus action you can move any number of them up to 30 feet to a point you can see within 120 feet.

subclasses.name: War Domain
subclasses.description: War gods watch over warriors and reward acts of martial prowess.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: Channel Divinity: When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll after rolling but before knowing the outcome.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant a +10 bonus to that roll.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon; this becomes 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.
